title: Navimower 0.4.2-beta2

Navimower 0.4.2-beta2 adds account-scoped notification read actions using the request contracts recovered from the official Navimow H5 Message Center in beta1.

### Notification read actions

- Added `navimower.mark_notification_read` for one Device notification. It opens the same encrypted message-detail route used by the official app (`/mowerbot/user/message/getmessageDetailResp`) with `message_id`, `type: 2`, and the target mower serial. The official app marks the row read locally before opening this detail view; beta2 deliberately waits for the subsequent Device-feed refresh before changing Home Assistant state, so field testing can confirm the server-side read effect rather than inventing it locally.
- Added `navimower.mark_all_notifications_read` using the confirmed encrypted `POST /mowerbot/user/message/clearBatchMessageRead` request with `searchMessageStatus: false` and the target mower serial.
- Both actions invalidate the notification poll TTL after a successful vendor call and request an immediate coordinator refresh. The `Latest notification` entity is therefore updated from a fresh `vehicleMessageListField` response instead of waiting for the normal 60-second notification interval.
- Read state remains scoped to the Navimow account used by this Home Assistant config entry. Marking notifications read in Home Assistant affects that account context, not every account to which the mower may be shared.

### Diagnostics cleanup

- Removed the beta1 `notification_read_h5_discovery` module and Download-diagnostics H5 fetches now that the notification request contracts have been recovered.
- Home Assistant Download diagnostics is snapshot-only again and does not perform public-H5 discovery or notification mutation calls.

### Compatibility and testing

- 0.4.2-beta2 is cumulative from stable 0.4.1 through 0.4.2-beta1; users do not need to install betas in sequence.
- Legacy Map Camera remains removed from the 0.4.2 line.
- Existing Notification, Error/Problem, map/history, settings and mower-control behavior is otherwise unchanged.
- `mark_all_notifications_read` follows a directly recovered official-app mutation contract. The single-message action uses the official detail-open route and remains explicitly field-validation behavior until a live unread message is confirmed `read: true` by the next Device-feed response.
